class EarlyRead {
  x: number;
  #amount: number;
  constructor() {
    console.log(this.x);
    console.log(this["x"]);
    (() => console.log(this.#amount))();
    this.x = 1;
    this.#amount = 2;
  }
}
class CompoundRead {
  value: number;
  constructor() {
    this.value += 1;
    console.log(this.value);
  }
}
class ConditionalWrite {
  value: number;
  constructor() {
    this.value &&= 1;
    console.log(this.value);
  }
}
class VoidField {
  value: void;
  constructor() { console.log(this.value); }
}
